properties.displayName: [WEEKLY] Web App Interpreter (Node/Python/Java/PHP) Spawns Shell or Net-Download LOLBin on Internet-Facing Host
properties.description:
Detects the post-exploitation execution tail of the May 11-16 2026 wave of authentication/authorization bypass disclosures in internet-facing application runtimes — Node.js, Python (uvicorn/gunicorn), Java, PHP-FPM, Ruby, .NET — where the application's own interpreter process unexpectedly spawns a shell (sh/bash/cmd/pwsh) or a network-staging LOLBin (curl/wget/nc/python -c). This fortnight the pattern is being driven by CVE-2026-44791 (n8n XML-node prototype pollution → RCE), CVE-2026-44338 (PraisonAI missing-auth, exploited within 4 hours of disclosure), CVE-2026-42074 (OpenClaude `dangerouslyDisableSandbox` model-controlled escape), CVE-2026-44849 (Portainer Swarm endpoint-security bypass to privileged container), and the Obot `/mcp-connect/{id}` ACR bypass — together with the Cisco SD-WAN CVE-2026-20182 and Burst Statistics CVE-2026-8181 auth bypasses whose follow-on stages share the same interpreter-spawns-shell shape. Kill-chain stages spanned: exploit → execution → ingress tool transfer / discovery, correlated to recent inbound public traffic on the same host. The rule fires when a baseline-rare interpreter→shell-or-LOLBin parent-child pair lands on a host that has received external inbound HTTP traffic in the same window; it does NOT fire on CI/CD runners, build agents, or developer workstations where node/python legitimately spawn shells as part of routine workflow — those parents should be added to the per-environment allowlist.

Rationale: Across all 12 fortnight articles the common observable tail of the auth/authz-bypass exploit is the same: the vulnerable application's own runtime — node, python, java, php-fpm, .net, n8n's node, OpenClaude's node, PraisonAI's python, Portainer's golang-into-container — spawns a shell or staging LOLBin shortly after unauthenticated external traffic hits the listening port. Anchoring on the interpreter→shell/LOLBin parent-child pair AND requiring co-temporal public inbound to the same host catches the joint chain while suppressing the legitimate CI/CD case where the same parent-child pair occurs without external probing.
properties.query:
let Lookback = 24h;
let WindowMin = 5m;
let InterpreterParents = dynamic(["node.exe","node","python.exe","python","python3","python3.exe","java.exe","java","php-fpm.exe","php-fpm","ruby","gunicorn","uvicorn","n8n.exe","n8n","dotnet.exe","dotnet","w3wp.exe"]);
let ShellLolBinChildren = dynamic(["sh","bash","zsh","dash","ash","cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","pwsh","curl.exe","curl","wget.exe","wget","nc","ncat","ncat.exe","python.exe","python","python3","perl","socat"]);
let InboundProbed = CommonSecurityLog
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
    | where DeviceAction in~ ("allow","accept","allowed","permit")
    | where DestinationPort in (80, 443, 8000, 8080, 8443, 5678, 9000, 9443, 3000)
    | where ipv4_is_private(SourceIP) == false
    | summarize ProbeTime = min(TimeGenerated), Probers = make_set(SourceIP, 25) by DestinationIP
    | extend Computer = tostring(DestinationIP);
let Children = ImProcessCreate
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
    | extend pParent = tolower(tostring(split(ParentProcessName, "/")[-1]))
    | extend pParent = tolower(tostring(split(pParent, "\\")[-1]))
    | extend pChild = tolower(tostring(split(TargetProcessName, "/")[-1]))
    | extend pChild = tolower(tostring(split(pChild, "\\")[-1]))
    | where pParent in (InterpreterParents)
    | where pChild in (ShellLolBinChildren)
    | where ActorUsername !endswith "$"
    | where isnotempty(TargetProcessCommandLine);
Children
| join kind=inner (InboundProbed | project Computer, ProbeTime, Probers) on $left.DvcHostname == $right.Computer
| where TimeGenerated between (ProbeTime .. ProbeTime + WindowMin)
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', TimeGenerated, ProbeTime)
| project TimeGenerated, DelaySec, DvcHostname, ActorUsername,
          ParentProcessName, ParentProcessCommandLine,
          TargetProcessName, TargetProcessCommandLine, Probers
| order by TimeGenerated desc
